methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were fetched directly for Vapi (vapi.ai/pricing, security.vapi.ai), Retell AI (retellai.com/pricing, docs.retellai.com/general/compliance), Bland AI (bland.ai/pricing, bland.ai/integrations), and Synthflow (synthflow.ai/pricing). Two vendors were REMOVED as not purchasable: (1) Air AI — the autonomous voice agent is defunct (services dark since late 2024; FTC complaint Aug 2025; March 2026 settlement with $18M judgment), and the air.ai domain now hosts an unrelated military/defense platform whose FedRAMP/IL5 certs do not belong to the voice product. (2) PlayAI — acquired by Meta July 2025, API shut down 2025-07-26, platform retired 2025-12-31; play.ai/pricing returns connection-refused and no plan can be purchased. billingModel='per_minute' for all retained vendors because all charge usage-based per-minute rates; monthlyUsd carries the published platform/seat fee where one exists and is null for contact-sales tiers. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Vapi
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched from vapi.ai/pricing; compliance from security.vapi.ai (Trust Center). HIPAA add-on is $2,000/month on Build; included on Scale. SOC2, GDPR, PCI DSS v4.0.1, and CCPA confirmed via Trust Center.

plans.name: Build
plans.notes: No upfront cost; pay-as-you-go at $0.05/min for call hosting. Model provider costs passed through at actual cost (or $0 with own API key). SMS/Chat: $0.005/message. 10 concurrent calls included; additional at $10/month each. HIPAA add-on $2,000/month. Zero Data Retention add-on $1,000/month. 14-day call history retention.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Annual contract with fixed platform fee plus committed volume. Volume-based per-minute pricing (negotiated). Includes SOC2, HIPAA, PCI, SSO, RBAC, enterprise SLA, and custom data retention. Price is custom / contact sales.

keyFeatures: API-first developer platform with full BYOK (bring your own LLM key) support
Call hosting at $0.05/min with model costs passed through at actual price
Enterprise compliance add-ons (HIPAA, Zero Data Retention) available on Build tier
Trusted by Amazon Ring, Intuit, ServiceTitan, New York Life
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from vapi.ai/pricing; compliance certifications (SOC2, GDPR, CCPA, PCI DSS v4.0.1) from Vapi Trust Center at security.vapi.ai. HIPAA available as add-on on Build and included on Scale.

vendors.name: Retell AI
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched from retellai.com/pricing; compliance from docs.retellai.com/general/compliance. SOC2 Type I & II, HIPAA, and GDPR confirmed. BAA available for self-signing on all plans including pay-as-you-go.

plans.name: Pay-as-You-Go
plans.notes: Starts with $10 in free credits; no commitments. Per-minute rate ranges $0.07–$0.31/min depending on LLM, TTS, and add-ons. Component breakdown: LLM $0.003–$0.16/min, Voice Infrastructure $0.055/min, TTS $0.015–$0.040/min, Telephony $0.015/min. Add-ons: Knowledge Base $0.005/min, PII Removal $0.01/min, AI QA $0.10/min (first 100 min free), Branded Calls $0.10/outbound call. 20 concurrent calls included; additional $8/month per slot. HIPAA BAA available for self-signing on this plan.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Unlimited concurrent calls, dedicated implementation support, 24/7 omnichannel support, custom DPA, custom BAA, custom MSA. Contact sales.

limits: 20 concurrent calls on pay-as-you-go (additional $8/month per slot)
$10 free credits to start (trial credits, not a forever-free plan)
Per-minute rate varies by LLM and TTS choices
keyFeatures: Transparent per-component pricing (LLM + STT + TTS + telephony shown separately)
HIPAA BAA available for self-signing on all plans including pay-as-you-go — no enterprise contract required
AI Quality Assurance add-on at $0.10/min with first 100 minutes free
enrichment.provenance: Pricing from retellai.com/pricing; compliance from docs.retellai.com/general/compliance confirming SOC2 Type I & II, HIPAA, and GDPR. BAA available for self-signing on all plans. freeTier is false — only $10 trial credits, no perpetual free plan.

vendors.name: Bland AI
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched from bland.ai/pricing; integrations from bland.ai/integrations. SOC2 Type I & II, HIPAA-eligible with signed BAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS all confirmed on the pricing page. Build $299/mo and Scale $499/mo corroborated by multiple 2026 sources.

plans.name: Start
plans.notes: No platform fee, no card required. $0.14/min talk time, $0.05/min transfer time. Includes 2 free credits and free inbound number ($15/month value). Limits: 10 concurrent calls, 100 calls/day, 1 voice clone, 10 knowledge bases. LLM, STT, TTS, and telephony all bundled into per-minute rate.

plans.name: Build
plans.notes: $299/month platform fee (does not include minutes; usage billed on top). $0.12/min talk time, $0.04/min transfer time. For teams. Limits: 50 concurrent calls, 2,000 calls/day, 5 voice clones, 50 knowledge bases. All-in bundled per-minute pricing (no third-party pass-throughs).

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: $499/month platform fee (does not include minutes; usage billed on top). $0.11/min talk time, $0.04/min transfer time. For high-volume use. Limits: 100 concurrent calls, 5,000 calls/day, 15 voice clones, 100 knowledge bases.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing contracted to volume. Unlimited concurrent calls, on-premises/VPC deployment, dedicated FDE, unlimited voice clones and knowledge bases. Contact sales.

limits: Subscription fees do not include minutes; usage billed on top
keyFeatures: All-inclusive bundled per-minute pricing — LLM, STT, TTS, and telephony in one rate, no third-party pass-throughs
SOC2 Type I & II, HIPAA (BAA on request), GDPR, and PCI DSS compliance
Broad contact-center telephony integrations (Genesys, Five9, NICE CXone, Amazon Connect, Talkdesk)
MCP server for Claude Code and Cursor integration
enrichment.provenance: Pricing and compliance from bland.ai/pricing; full integration list from bland.ai/integrations. All four compliance standards (SOC2 Type I & II, HIPAA-eligible with BAA, GDPR, PCI DSS) stated directly on the pricing page. Build $299/mo and Scale $499/mo verified.

vendors.name: Synthflow
vendors.provenance: Pricing and compliance fetched directly from synthflow.ai/pricing. SOC2 and GDPR on all plans; HIPAA listed as Enterprise-only. Enterprise adds on-premise hosting. No fixed monthly subscription tiers (Starter/Pro/Growth) exist — usage-based Pay As You Go only.

plans.name: Pay As You Go
plans.notes: Free to start; usage-based billing. Voice Engine: $0.09/min. LLM add-ons range $0.02–$0.05/min depending on model. Synthflow Twilio telephony $0.02/min or BYOT $0.00/min. Total typical range $0.15–$0.24/min. 5 concurrent calls included; additional concurrency $20/unit/month. Phone numbers $1.50 each. White-Label + Custom Domain add-on $2,000/month. Performance Routing $0.04/min. Global Low Latency Edge $0.04/min.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Minimum 10,000 minutes/month. Custom per-minute pricing. Unlimited concurrent calls, Synthflow Native Telephony, white-label toolkit, 99.99% SLA. Adds HIPAA, MSA support, geo-based sub-processing, on-premise multi-region deployment. Contact sales.

limits: 5 concurrent calls on Pay As You Go (additional $20/unit/month)
keyFeatures: Modular per-minute pricing: voice engine, LLM, and telephony priced separately so you can BYOT
SOC2 and GDPR on all plans; HIPAA on Enterprise
White-label toolkit with custom domain option
enrichment.provenance: All data from synthflow.ai/pricing fetched directly. Voice engine base rate confirmed at $0.09/min; total range $0.15–$0.24/min depending on LLM and telephony selections. HIPAA listed as Enterprise-only. No fixed-fee subscription tiers exist.
